name: amazon_search_first_result_price
intent: Search Amazon for a product and report the price of the first result
description: Searches Amazon for the requested product, identifies the first result shown, and returns that product's name and price.
patterns: search for a product and tell me the price of the first result
what is the price of the first result for this product
look up a product and report its first result price
find the first result price for a product

inputs.name: search_query
inputs.description: The product or search term to look up on Amazon.

steps.intent: Tap Search to open Amazon search
Type {{search_query}} into the Search Amazon field and submit the search

outputs.name: first_result_product
outputs.example: KODAK AA Alkaline Batteries (24 Pack) Double A Battery, LR6, 1.5V | 10-Year Shelf Life, Advanced Leak-Resistant Design,…

outputs.name: first_result_price
outputs.near: KODAK AA Alkaline Batteries (24 Pack) Double A Battery, LR6, 1.5V | 10-Year Shelf Life, Advanced Leak-Resistant Design,…
